_comment: R-A door-event vectors: pins the DoorOpen/DoorClosed vocabulary on the REAL WorldEventFeed.Append path (fail-loud kind/key validation - SectionsD-style direct WorldEvent construction would bypass it). expect blocks recorded once via `dotnet run -- <fixtures> --record` and reviewed. Reviewed canon shows the law: door events move the history hash but leave NO trace in the projected view (audit-trail facts, no estimation). Polling dedup ('exactly one event per observed state flip') lives in the adapter (WorldEventsUnity.PollDoors, snapshot diff like the damage dials) and is NOT reproducible in Core - the event lists below are what a flipped door produces, one per flip.

cases.name: ra_door_events_roundtrip
cases.comment: Open -> close -> open a second door: one DoorOpen/DoorClosed pair per flip (adapter snapshot dedup law), replay bit-identical, projected canon free of door traces.

payload.objective: Open the door to the command center.

expect.objective: Open the door to the command center.
expect.canon:
mission=vector|ra_door_events_roundtrip
round=4
posture=stall
objective=Open the door to the command center.
objective_actor=
threat=0
threatseen=0
seq=5
G|STORM|STORM|1|0|2|2|1|0|1|name=Stormtroopers

cases.name: ra_door_interleaved_with_shot
cases.comment: Door events interleaved INSIDE a hero window carrying a GroupDamage: the shot attribution column is unaffected by door traffic, and door events leave no canon trace even mid-window.

expect.canon:
mission=vector|ra_door_interleaved_with_shot
round=2
posture=eliminate
objective=Defeat the rebel cell.
objective_actor=
threat=0
threatseen=0
seq=7
G|STORM|STORM|1|0|2|2|1|5|9/10|name=Stormtroopers|shot=Lokaku|5|2
H|Lokaku|Lokaku|0|0|1|2|0|0
seen=Lokaku zone=door:d-x kind=fact seq=6 round=2

cases.name: ra_door_resync_relog
cases.comment: Resync shape: the adapter's full re-log states every digital door AS IT IS with resync:true (same full-current-state law as the GroupDamage dial re-log); the vocabulary accepts it and the re-log replays bit-identically.
